digest.component_or_area: CI verification workflow and script porting
propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh shell script must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point that accepts CONCLUSION and FAILURE_OBSERVED environment variables and outputs a vote in {success, failure, cancelled}

The subprocess-driven contract test in tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py must be re-pointed at the Python entry point while preserving its full case table and adding direct in-process unit tests of the function

gerrit-verify.yaml workflow must update the sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new .py file (with cone-mode: false) and update the run invocation to call the Python entry point

The Python entry point must implement fail-closed logic: skipped + FAILURE_OBSERVED=true maps to failure, empty or unrecognized CONCLUSION maps to failure, and FAILURE_OBSERVED defaults to false when unset
